notes: Efficient T5 win: Maintenance Access HQ steal plus Bravado R&D steal (Tomorrow's Headline) on T3, then Tomorrow's Headline steals from Server 1 through Starlit Knight on T4 and T5. Minor oddities: three click-for-credit clicks T1, and paying clicks and credits to clear Starlit Knight tags (T3, T5) right before running back into the same tag ice.

Won T14 by scoring Sericulture Expansion and three Project Yagi-Udas from iced remotes. Held Hedge Fund on T1 with 5 credits (the runner saw it in HQ) instead of playing it, left HQ unprotected until T3, and spent T3, T12 and T13 mostly clicking for credits; the runner never contested.

After bouncing off Akhet on T4, the runner clicked for credits for almost every click of T4-T17, reaching 62 credits. Meanwhile the corp openly advanced and scored Divested Trust (T5, T9, T12), Transport Monopoly (T7) and Above the Law (T13, T17) in Server 2. The single good turn (T10: trash ZATO City Grid, steal Divested Trust from R&D) shows the runner could get in and chose not to.

Rezzed Nico Campaign T2 down to 1 credit and sat at 0-4 credits through T4-T15 (T4 was three credit clicks and then a discard), so Megaprix Qualifier in Server 2 was stolen with Overclock on T5. Later scored Megaprix, Project Ingatan and Méliès City Luxury Line behind Eli/Ansel, and used the Ansel 1.0 subs well (installing ice into Server 2).

Strong T7 win: two R&D steals on T1 (Witch Hunt, Stoke the Embers), a Laser Pointer bypass of Starlit Knight on T4, Window of Opportunity installing Poison Vial with Carmen into HQ for Tomorrow's Headline on T5, and R&D pressure for Freedom of Information. Going to 0 credits on T1 and never clearing tags (Daily Casts was trashed while tagged) were small risks.

On T1 it clicked for credits three times with no ice anywhere, and Megaprix Qualifier was stolen from the open HQ. Credit clicks with 15 credits and 6 cards on T6-T7 were wasted. Architect Deployment Test sat in an 8-card HQ behind one Eli 1.0 and was stolen T14. Good scoring turns: ADT T9, Seamless Launch into Méliès T11, Superconducting Hub T13 and Ingatan T17 using Otto Campaign clicks.

Won T8 with cheap HQ steals through Paywall (Remastered Edition T3, Artificial Cryptocrash T4) and R&D steals through Funhouse (taking tags). T6 was odd: it spent 3 credits on Living Mural and then ran Server 1 into an unrezzed Capacitor while carrying tags, which ended the run.

Reached 6 points by T3 (two Server 1 steals through Afshar with Buzzsaw, Transport Monopoly from HQ), then clicked for credits for almost every click of T7-T26, reaching 75 credits. Meanwhile the corp advanced and scored Above the Law (T8, T12), Divested Trust (T10) and Transport Monopoly (T27) from remotes. One steal would have won at any point. T2 also ran R&D three times in a row, seeing the same top card.

The economy never got going: it clicked for credits through T4-T7 and sat at 0-3 credits from T9 on, so the two outer ice in Server 4 were never rezzed. Regenesis (T9) and both Lotus Hazes (installed T12 and T14) were installed into Server 4, where the runner had already shown it could break Hafrún, and were stolen T9, T13 and T15. Esca/Urtica traps and the Hybrid Release recursion were reasonable.

Clean T13 win: Bladderwort economy and Longevity Serum, Sisyphus Protocol and Hybrid Release scored behind Semak-samun in Server 2, then See How They Run protected by Anemone with a Sisyphus re-encounter. R&D was unprotected on T1 (Hybrid Release stolen), and the opponent was passive.

Won T22 by building a 4-ice Server 1 and scoring Post-Truth Dividend twice, Tomorrow's Headline twice and Embedded Reporting. Two agendas were stolen: Tomorrow's Headline T8 behind just Ping and Paywall, and Next Big Thing T18, which was left at 2 advancements over a turn. There were several pure credit-click turns (T7, T15, T17) while holding cards.

Won T21, but its economy was at 0-6 credits most of the game. It spent 5 credits per Boi-tatá break on Ballista for HQ runs that hit Luana Campos, Hammer and Tree Line (T9, T11, T13, T14) and made frequent Archives runs, while the corp advanced and scored Above the Law (T13) and Transport Monopoly (T15, T21) in Server 1. The SDS Drone Deployment steal T16 and the Banner R&D steals T20-T21 were good.

Never scored. It clicked for credits T2 and T4-T6 with Tomorrow's Headline in HQ (stolen T3). On T7 it spent everything on Oppo Research for 4 tags with no punishment beyond trashing Daily Casts. That left Embedded Reporting in Server 1 with 2 credits, and it was stolen T8 past unrezzed ice. From T11-T13 it was stuck at 0 credits trashing Daily Casts while R&D, swapped weak by Tāo, gave up the last agenda.

Clicked for credits on T1-T4 without running while the corp scored two Hybrid Releases. The one in Server 3 (behind unrezzed ice, installed T3) was there to contest. T3 installed a second Pennyshaver that was immediately trashed. T5 ran into the Jinteki remote and then Jailbreak R&D through Anemone while Prāna Condenser built up 5 counters, ending with 4 cards in grip and getting flatlined T6.

Fast T5 win: Tread Lightly R&D steal of Longevity Serum T1, Revolver plus Docklands Pass HQ runs, a Hybrid Release from Archives T4, and Fujii Asset Retrieval plus Hybrid Release from HQ T5. It ran HQ through Anemone T2 down to 1 card in grip against Jinteki, which was risky but worked.

Spent down to 0-3 credits early (Otto/Nico rezzes) and installed Architect Deployment Test T3 behind ice it could not rez, so it was stolen. Megaprix (T7) and Méliès (T12) were stolen through Hagen. On T10-T11 it took Hedge Fund plus two credit clicks with 6 cards in HQ instead of adding ice, but it won T14 when the runner could not pay to steal the second Méliès.

Won T7 by using Banner to push through ETR ice (Tree Line, Akhet) and stealing Above the Law, SDS Drone Deployment (trashing Boi-tatá) and Above the Law again from Server 1. Minor inefficiency: back-to-back Archives runs T3-T4 and some credit clicks.

Scored Fujii Asset Retrieval T5 well, but then sat at 0-5 credits for T6-T17 with repeated credit-click turns (T7, T8, T13, T16). It left Project Yagi-Uda unadvanced in Server 1 from T6 to T14. R&D had only Hafrún and leaked Sericulture Expansion twice and Hybrid Release. Won T17 only because the runner was also poor.

Mostly strong: Project Ingatan T2 behind Hagen, Nico/Petty Cash economy, ADT T10 and Méliès T12 using Seamless Launch. The clear mistake came on T10, when it used the ADT trigger to install a second Architect Deployment Test into a new unprotected remote (Server 4), and the runner stole it at once. HQ was also left open T1-T3.

Went to 0 credits T1 (Living Mural plus Gauss) and never rebuilt, staying at 0-3 credits all game. It repeatedly re-ran R&D in the same turn with no draw in between, seeing the same top card (T1, T2, T3, T7, T8), and made four low-value HQ runs on each of T9-T10. It also piled up Vasilisa tags that enabled Backroom Machinations T8, and had no way into Server 1 when Artificial Cryptocrash was scored T11.
